nodes.description: owner: privileged address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, delegate and whitelists in ensure.
balanceOf mapping holding token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; written in approve and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
_onSaleNum mapping counting transfers per address, used as sale limit in condition and incremented in transferFrom.
canSale mapping used in ensure as the 'go the white address first' bypass flag.
_minSale minimum transfer amount set in init and enforced in condition.
_maxSale maximum transfer amount set in init and enforced in condition.
_saleNum per-address sale count limit set in init and enforced in condition.
tradeAddress whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress and used in ensure.
totalSupply public token supply assigned in the constructor.
decimals constant (18) used for scaling amounts in init and the constructor.
name public token name set in the constructor.
symbol public token symbol set in the constructor.
UNI constant router address (0x7a25...) whitelisted in ensure and pre-approved in the constructor.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist check for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale then condition().
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall on attacker-controlled target a.
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only, writes _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass balance transfer with unchecked multiplication.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only write of the tradeAddress whitelist.
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; computes the Uniswap V2 pair address.
SHIBANIKE constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets owner, supply, balances, name, symbol and infinite UNI allowance.
msg.sender: caller-controlled origin of transfer/transferFrom/approve and the only access-control check in owner-gated functions.
a.delegatecall(b): low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary owner-supplied address, executes foreign code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value: unchecked arithmetic on a user-controlled value (no SafeMath).
balanceOf[_to] += _value: unchecked arithmetic that can silently wrap.
total = _value * _tos.length: unchecked multiplication allowing overflow in batchSend.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked arithmetic decrement of an allowance.
parameter _to of transfer: recipient address, forwarded to transferFrom.
parameter _value of transfer: transfer amount, forwarded to transferFrom.
parameter _from of ensure: sender address tested against whitelists.
parameter _to of ensure: recipient address tested against owner.
parameter _value of ensure: amount passed to condition().
local _UNI: computed pair address used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
parameter _from of transferFrom: source account for allowance and balance mutation.
parameter _to of transferFrom: destination account for balance credit.
parameter _value of transferFrom: amount moved and used in unchecked arithmetic.
parameter _spender of approve: allowance beneficiary.
parameter _value of approve: allowance amount written to storage.
parameter a of delegate: arbitrary target address of the delegatecall.
parameter b of delegate: arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
parameter saleNum of init: sets the _saleNum limit.
parameter token of init: multiplied by 10**decimals to set _minSale.
parameter maxToken of init: multiplied by 10**decimals to set _maxSale.
parameter _tos of batchSend: recipient array whose length multiplies _value.
parameter _value of batchSend: per-recipient amount, also used in unchecked multiplication.
local total: _value * _tos.length, computed without overflow protection.
parameter addr of setTradeAddress: new whitelisted trading address.
parameter _from of condition: address whose _onSaleNum is compared to _saleNum.
parameter _value of condition: amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale.

edges.reason: transfer delegates the whole operation to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
caller-supplied _to is forwarded to transferFrom.
caller-supplied _value is forwarded to transferFrom.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for whitelisting.
ensure compares _from/_to against the privileged owner state variable.
ensure treats the hardcoded UNI router as a whitelisted sender.
ensure treats the owner-controlled tradeAddress as whitelisted.
ensure consults canSale[_from] as an arbitrary bypass flag.
ensure falls through to condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
_from parameter flows into the whitelist comparisons.
_to parameter flows into the owner comparison.
_value parameter flows into condition().
the local _UNI pair address is used in the whitelist test.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender] for spender authorisation.
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf state for sender and recipient.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] for every transfer.
spender identity is derived from msg.sender when msg.sender != _from.
transferFrom reaches the unchecked balance subtraction operation.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom executes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
_from parameter drives allowance, ensure and balance checks.
_to parameter receives the credited balance.
_value parameter feeds all unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve grants spending rights keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
_spender parameter becomes the allowance key.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
condition reads the per-address _onSaleNum counter.
_from parameter selects the _onSaleNum entry compared to the limit.
_value parameter is range-checked against min and max sale.
delegate authorises the caller solely by comparing msg.sender to owner.
delegate reads the owner state variable for its require gate.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the caller.
parameter a is the arbitrary delegatecall target.
parameter b is the arbitrary delegatecall calldata.
init gates privileged state writes on msg.sender == owner.
init compares the caller against the owner state variable.
init writes the _minSale state variable.
init writes the _maxSale state variable.
init writes the _saleNum state variable.
init scales limits using the decimals constant.
parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum.
parameter token is scaled into _minSale.
parameter maxToken is scaled into _maxSale.
batchSend restricts execution with msg.sender == owner.
batchSend compares the caller against the owner state variable.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries in a loop without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked.
parameter _tos length multiplies _value and drives the credit loop.
parameter _value is both multiplied and credited per recipient.
local total carries the unchecked product used for the balance check.
setTradeAddress is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress compares the caller against the owner state variable.
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
parameter addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, defining all future privilege.
constructor derives the privileged owner from msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals without overflow guard.
constructor mints the whole supply to the deployer in balanceOf.
constructor grants the UNI router an infinite allowance.
constructor stores the token name.
constructor stores the token symbol.
the delegatecall executes external code with full storage access, allowing state such as balanceOf to be re-modified mid-transaction.
transferFrom updates balances before any external interaction, and the low-level call path in the linked ERC20 helpers can re-enter transfer state.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only meaningful as the transfer argument and should collapse into the transfer function node.
Parameter _value is only used to forward into transferFrom and should collapse into transfer.
Parameter _from is only consumed by the ensure whitelist logic.
Parameter _to is only consumed by the ensure owner comparison.
Parameter _value is only forwarded from ensure to condition.
Local _UNI is an intermediate pair address computed inside ensure.
Parameter _from is the core account argument of transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the core recipient argument of transferFrom.
Parameter _value drives every unchecked arithmetic write in transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is only used as the approve allowance key.
Parameter _value is only used as the approve allowance amount.
Parameter a is the arbitrary target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter saleNum is only written into the _saleNum limit by init.
Parameter token is only scaled into the _minSale limit by init.
Parameter maxToken is only scaled into the _maxSale limit by init.
Parameter _tos only supplies the loop recipients and multiplier length in batchSend.
Parameter _value only feeds the unguarded amount arithmetic in batchSend.
Local total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
Parameter addr is only written into the tradeAddress whitelist by setTradeAddress.
Parameter _from only selects the checked _onSaleNum entry inside condition.
Parameter _value is only range-checked against sale limits inside condition.
